say:1:1310407001:0.text: Good evening, everyone. You have arrived just in time, the ball is about to begin.
say:1:1310407001:0.source_cn: 诸位，夜安。你们来得正好，舞会快要开始了。

say:2:1310407002:0.text: Good evening! Wait, you didn't change into your ball attire? I was hoping to see you in a formal suit...
say:2:1310407002:0.source_cn: 晚上好。咦，你没有换舞会的服装呢，我还以为可以见到穿着...

say:3:1310407003:0.text: Ah, sorry to disappoint. I still have the duty of patrolling the area and addressing the undead situation. A formal suit would be rather impractical.
say:3:1310407003:0.source_cn: 啊，抱歉，没法满足你的要求了。我还得负责巡视场地，驱逐...

say:4:1310407004:0.text: *Giggle* You're the politest and most courteous wolf I've ever met!
say:4:1310407004:0.source_cn: 呀，法拉莫尔先生是我见过最温柔最有礼貌的狼先生了！

say:5:1310407005:0.text: That being said, I urge everyone to remain vigilant. The number of attendees is considerable, and I harbor concerns that some unwelcome guests may arrive...
say:5:1310407005:0.source_cn: 话说回来，请诸位务必注意安全。参加舞会的人很多，你知道...

say:6:1310407006:0.text: Don't worry! We can take care of ourselves!
say:6:1310407006:0.source_cn: 放心吧！我们能保护好自己，也会提高警戒！
